summary: Reviews step 1: a read-only pull request view. A third top-level view, Reviews, beside Chats and Board, lists the pull requests of every project whose git remote is on github.com or bitbucket.org, grouped by what you do next (Needs you, Waiting on others, Ready to merge, Merged this week; rule in src/shared/pull-request-groups.ts), one icon and one short phrase per row. The detail pane has Overview (failed-check callout, description, activity, merge blockers, reviewers, checks), Files (a one-level tree and a read-only unified diff with inline review threads), Conversations (Open / Resolved inline threads, path opens the file) and Checks. GitHub is read through the gh CLI where the backend runs (gh api graphql + REST files); Bitbucket Cloud through REST 2.0 with an Atlassian email + API token entered in Settings > Accounts & models > Source control, encrypted with Electron safeStorage in its own file under userData, never in the settings table or settings.json, and never sent back to the renderer. Everything is behind one PullRequestProvider interface and served by backend handlers on every host (Electron IPC, the phone's WS/TCP, the headless server). The pull-requests:* channels are open to a paired phone; source-control:* is admin-scoped by prefix. No write call exists: no comment, approve, merge, resolve or re-run. The list refreshes on window focus (at most once a minute) and every 5 minutes while the view is shown, and a per-PR cache keyed by the host's updated time keeps Bitbucket from re-reading checks and comments of unchanged PRs.

reactNativeIos.followUpRelease: mobile-v0.5.0. The backend already answers pull-requests:* for a paired phone and the shared contract (src/shared/pull-requests.ts, pull-request-groups.ts) is transport-agnostic, so the phone needs only a Reviews tab reading those channels and grouping with groupPullRequests. Nothing on the phone reaches it before then: no screen, route or call exists, and the tab ships behind the local mobile_reviews flag. Credentials stay desktop-only by design (source-control:* is admin-scoped).

nativeAndroid.followUpRelease: Native Android 0.6.0: a Reviews destination over the same pull-requests:* channels, behind the native_reviews flag. No Android code calls these channels in this release, so nothing unfinished is reachable.

storageDataMigration.reason: No database schema change and no migration. The Bitbucket email + API token live in one new file, userData/source-control/bitbucket.bin, encrypted with Electron safeStorage and written only when the user saves an account (src/main/pull-requests/credentials.ts, tested in tests/unit/source-control-credentials.test.ts); it is not in the settings table, so settings.json and settings:get never see it. The existing layout.appView settings row gains the value 'reviews'; an older build reading it falls back to chats. PR data is cached in memory only.

updateRelease.reason: No package identity, signing, deep link, update channel or wire-protocol frame change. The new channels are additive request/response channels; an older desktop or phone never calls them, and a newer client against an older backend gets the ordinary unknown-channel error. No schema migration: the only new stored data is one new file, userData/source-control/bitbucket.bin, created when the user saves a Bitbucket account, plus the existing layout.appView settings row accepting the value 'reviews' (an older build reading it falls back to chats).

automated: npm test passed (see the PR for counts). New: pull-requests-github-map (GraphQL list/detail/threads and REST files fixtures, gh error classes, a missing repo reported on its own, token never asked for), pull-requests-bitbucket-map (pullrequests, participants, comments with nested replies and resolution, commit statuses, diffstat + diff, activity; fake fetch for 401/403/404/429/offline, no token sent to another origin, enrichment cache), pull-request-remote (https/ssh/scp remotes, upstream before origin), pull-request-groups (every group and phrase), pull-request-refresh (5 minute interval, 1 minute focus floor, VersionedCache expiry and LRU), pull-request-service (repo detection, no_account / needs_desktop per host, refusing repositories that are not projects), source-control-credentials (encrypted file, refusal without safeStorage, nothing on the settings.json allow-list), review-states (one line + one fix per error kind), device-auth (a phone may call pull-requests:* and none of source-control:*).

SB_VISUAL_SCOPE=screens e2e/visual-regressions.e2e.mjs: new reviews and reviews-files baselines in Dark, Light and Translucent from the demo provider (SB_DEMO_ADAPTER=1). chat, kanban and confirm-dialog changed only inside the title-bar toggle box (x 1068-1225, y 7-31) for the third button; settings-accounts changed for the longer page description and scrollbar. Every other rewritten PNG had no pixel over the threshold and was restored. Two further runs without updating both passed.

Live read-only check of the GitHub provider against tejasnafde/switchboard with the local gh login: list (16 PRs, rollups, threads), detail of #159 (sizes, activity, 6 checks with durations), 5 review threads, 10 changed files with parsed hunks, and a missing PR mapped to not_found.

Round 2: the diff parser normalises CRLF (a Windows checkout turned the raw diff fixture into CRLF and the path lookup missed); tests feed a CRLF Bitbucket diff and a CRLF GitHub patch, and both fail without the fix. .gitattributes pins tests/fixtures/pull-requests/** to LF. A failed Bitbucket account removal is logged and still rejects (pull-requests-ipc). Cached tabs are dropped when a PR's check rollup or open-conversation count changes, not only its updated time (pullRequestChanged).
hardware: Every new baseline PNG, plus Conversations, Checks, jump-to-file, the list filter and the Source control settings cards, was opened and checked by eye on this Mac.
notExercised: Bitbucket was never called live: no Bitbucket token is configured on this machine. Its mapping is tested only against fixtures written from the public API reference.
The headless server path (src/server) was not run; its needs_desktop state is covered by unit tests only. Storing Bitbucket credentials on a headless backend is deferred.
A project on a remote machine: PR reads go to the base backend, not per-machine routing.
React Native and native Android are staged; nothing was run on a phone.
